issues.t: Fuel pump can fail and cut drive power (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stumbles, stalls or shuts off while you are driving and may not restart. There may be no warning light first.
issues.why: The electric fuel pump in the tank can fail and stop feeding fuel to the engine. Recall 23V-630 covered 2022 models and was expanded by 24V-282 to 2022-2023 models.
issues.next: Run your VIN through a Genesis dealer or nhtsa.gov. The dealer inspects and replaces the fuel pump assembly for free. If the engine has already stalled, have it towed in rather than driving it.

issues.t: Fuel can leak where the fuel pipe meets the fuel rail (recall)
issues.sym: A smell of gasoline around the engine bay, or wet fuel near the top of the engine.
issues.why: The joint between the fuel supply pipe and the fuel rail that feeds the injectors may not stay sealed, which can let fuel leak onto hot engine parts. Recall 26V-229 covers 2022-2026 GV70s.
issues.next: If you smell fuel, park outside away from buildings and do not keep driving. Ask a dealer to check your VIN; they inspect and tighten or replace the fuel pipe for free.

issues.t: Seat belt pretensioner can burst in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: Nothing you can notice day to day. The problem only shows up when the front seat belt pretensioners fire in a crash.
issues.why: The small explosive charge that tightens the front seat belts in a crash can rupture its housing and throw metal fragments into the cabin. Recall 21V-796 (2022) was replaced by 23V-094, which covers 2022-2023 GV70s.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 21V-796 and 23V-094. The dealer fits a cap over each pretensioner for free. Cars fixed under the first recall still need the newer repair.

issues.t: Transmission can slip out of Park from wet wiring (recall)
issues.sym: The SUV may roll after you park it, or warning lights appear for the shifter or transmission.
issues.why: Water can get into the transmission control wiring harness and short it, which can move the transmission from Park to Neutral on its own. Recall 24V-205 covers 2024 GV70s.
issues.next: Until the recall is done, always set the electric parking brake and switch the SUV off when you park. A dealer repairs the connector or replaces the harness for free.

issues.t: Instrument display can go blank (recall)
issues.sym: The digital gauge screen behind the steering wheel goes dark, so you can't see speed or warning lights.
issues.why: A software error can crash the instrument display. Recall 25V-105 covers 2025 GV70s and 26V-019 covers 2025-2026 models; the second one is linked to the HD radio feature.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to check your VIN for recalls 25V-105 and 26V-019. The software update is free and may come over the air. Genesis advises turning HD radio off until 26V-019 is done.

issues.t: Instrument display can go blank on the Electrified GV70 (recall)
issues.sym: The digital gauge cluster goes dark while driving, hiding speed and warning lights.
issues.why: A software fault in the instrument display. Recall 25V-105 includes 2023-2025 Electrified GV70s.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V-105. The dealer updates the display software for free.

issues.t: Side curtain airbags may not be installed correctly (recall)
issues.sym: Usually nothing you can see. In some cases the airbag warning light may come on.
issues.why: On some 2026 GV70s the side curtain airbags in the roof may not have been fitted correctly at the factory, so they might not open as designed in a crash. This is recall 25V-809.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V-809. The dealer reinstalls the curtain airbags for free.

issues.t: Charging control unit can fail and cut power (recall)
issues.sym: A 'Stop vehicle and check power supply' or 'Check electric vehicle system' warning, sometimes after a pop, then power drops sharply or the SUV won't go faster than a crawl. Some owners are left stranded.
issues.why: The Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) charges the 12-volt battery from the main battery. It can be damaged and stop charging, so the 12-volt system runs down and drive power is lost. Recall 24V-204 was replaced by 24V-868; owners report failures even after the first software fix.
issues.next: Make sure both recalls are done. If the warning appears, pull over safely and call for a tow. The dealer replaces the ICCU and fuse as needed and updates the software for free.

issues.t: Loss of power from a punctured intercooler radiator
issues.sym: Coolant leaks or the level drops, then the SUV suddenly won't accelerate, often when merging or passing. The engine may rev without pulling, and a check engine code such as P26CB00 may be stored.
issues.why: The turbo engines use a separate coolant radiator to cool the intake air. It sits behind a wide lower grille opening, and owners and dealers report small stones getting through and puncturing it. Once it leaks, the electric pump for that circuit can run dry and fail.
issues.next: Have any coolant leak checked early. Dealers have usually treated this as road damage, so ask your insurer about comprehensive coverage. Some owners fit a mesh screen behind the lower grille afterwards.

issues.t: Check engine light for the intercooler coolant pump
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with code P26CB00 and the engine may lose some power.
issues.why: The small electric water pump that moves coolant through the intercooler circuit on the 3.5L V6 can get its impeller stuck. Genesis issued bulletin 25-01-062G for this.
issues.next: Have the code read and ask the dealer about bulletin 25-01-062G. This is normally a warranty repair on cars this new.

issues.t: Scraping noise and stalling from torque converter damage
issues.sym: A scraping or grinding noise from the transmission area. In rare cases the engine stalls at idle or while creeping forward.
issues.why: Rivets inside the torque converter, which links the engine to the automatic transmission, can be damaged or crack. Bulletins 23-01-003G and 23-01-003G-1 cover it.
issues.next: If it stalls in traffic, stop driving and have the SUV towed to a dealer. The fix is a new torque converter, normally under the powertrain warranty.

issues.t: Misfire and check engine light on cold starts (2.5 turbo)
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with misfire codes (P0300-P0304), usually right after a cold start. The engine may idle roughly for a moment.
issues.why: The engine computer's cold-start settings on the 2.5L turbo can cause misfires. Genesis bulletin 25-01-051G adds updated software. RepairPal also lists multiple-cylinder misfires as a reported GV70 problem.
issues.next: Have the codes read. If it is only the cold-start misfire, the dealer updates the engine computer. If misfires continue, the spark plugs and coils should be checked.

issues.t: AWD warning from the transfer case actuator
issues.sym: An AWD or 4WD warning message on the dash, with transfer case codes such as P1960, P1958 or P1955.
issues.why: The electric actuator that controls how much power goes to the front wheels can fault. Genesis bulletin 23-DS-002G gives the dealer a step-by-step fix.
issues.next: The SUV usually still drives in rear-wheel drive. Have the codes read and ask about bulletin 23-DS-002G. Avoid slippery roads until it is fixed.

issues.t: Hum or whine from the rear differential
issues.sym: A hum or whine from the back of the SUV at certain speeds, often changing as you speed up or lift off.
issues.why: A lock nut in the rear differential can loosen. Genesis bulletin 23-DS-004G covers the GV70, GV80 and G80. RepairPal also lists a rear whine as a GV70 complaint.
issues.next: Have the dealer listen for it and check the differential. The bulletin calls for tightening the lock nut or replacing parts if needed.

issues.t: Forward collision system brakes for no reason
issues.sym: The SUV suddenly brakes hard or stops on its own with a forward collision warning, even with nothing ahead.
issues.why: Owners report false triggering of the forward collision-avoidance system. One case on a 2025 was followed by an active air flap fault, pointing to a sensor problem in the front end.
issues.next: Report each event to the dealer and to NHTSA. Keep the front sensors and grille clear of snow and dirt, and ask for a full driver-assist and sensor check.

issues.t: Coolant loss from the thermal management module
issues.sym: The coolant level keeps dropping with no warning light, and the leak comes back after repairs.
issues.why: An owner traced repeat coolant loss to the integrated thermal management module that controls coolant flow. Low coolant can overheat the engine.
issues.next: Check the coolant tank level when the engine is cold. If it keeps dropping, get it diagnosed under warranty and keep every repair invoice.

issues.t: Moisture inside the headlights
issues.sym: Fog or water droplets inside one or both headlights, making them dimmer at night. It can come back after the lights are replaced.
issues.why: Moisture gets into the sealed headlight housings. Owners report it on both sides and say a replacement didn't solve it for good.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to inspect the lights while you are under warranty. If water pools inside, the assembly usually has to be replaced.

issues.t: Windshield cracks easily
issues.sym: A loud pop and a crack in the windshield with no impact, or long cracks spreading from small stone chips.
issues.why: Owners report the windshield cracking from small chips or for no clear reason, with some needing several replacements.
issues.next: Fix chips quickly before they spread. Check whether your insurance covers glass, and ask for a camera recalibration after any windshield replacement.

issues.t: Cracks in the side sill panels
issues.sym: Cracks in the body panels along the bottom of the doors (the side sills).
issues.why: Genesis bulletin 23-01-001G says the side sill panels on some 2022 GV70s may crack.
issues.next: Have the dealer inspect the sills and repair any cracks under warranty, before water gets in.

issues.t: Squeak from the rear suspension
issues.sym: A squeak from the rear when going over bumps.
issues.why: The left rear coil spring may sit out of place in its seat. Genesis bulletin 22-01-053G covers it.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check the spring position. The fix is an inspection and adjustment.

issues.t: Infotainment update doesn't finish
issues.sym: The screen shows that an over-the-air software update failed or did not complete.
issues.why: Over-the-air updates may not install fully on the sixth-generation navigation system. Genesis bulletin 24-01-044G covers it.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check the software version and finish the update.

issues.t: Center screen flickers or goes blank
issues.sym: The center display flickers or blacks out for a moment, then comes back.
issues.why: The shield on a video cable connector can be slightly too wide and lose contact. Bulletin 24-BE-016G covers it.
issues.next: Have the dealer adjust the cable connector under warranty.

issues.t: Center console cover peels
issues.sym: The upper cover of the center console starts to peel or bubble.
issues.why: The cover material can come away from the console. Genesis bulletin 24-01-067G covers it.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to inspect it; the console assembly is replaced if needed.

issues.t: Steering wheel call button sticks
issues.sym: The phone button on the steering wheel stays pressed in or doesn't spring back.
issues.why: Bulletin 24-01-028G covers a sticking call button on 2023-2024 Electrified GV70s and 2024 GV70s.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to replace the button under warranty.

issues.t: Electrified GV70 stops charging
issues.sym: Charging stops partway through, and an EV warning light comes on with code P1ABD00.
issues.why: The charging system reads the charge port as too hot and shuts charging down. Bulletin 23-EV-005G updates the charge management software.
issues.next: Try another charger to rule it out. If it keeps happening, ask the dealer for the software update.

issues.t: Brake lights and i-Pedal software update
issues.sym: Brake lights may not behave as expected during regenerative braking, or one-pedal driving acts oddly.
issues.why: Bulletin 23-01-082G updates the vehicle control software for brake-light logic during regenerative braking, i-Pedal mode and the 12-volt battery saver.
issues.next: Ask the dealer whether the update has been installed.

issues.t: Door trim panel coming apart
issues.sym: The door trim panel material separates or peels.
issues.why: Bulletin 23-01-079G covers door trim separation on some 2023 Electrified GV70s built in certain date ranges.
issues.next: Have the dealer inspect the panels and replace them under warranty if needed.

issues.t: Check engine light from the active air flap sensor
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with code P059A. A front collision warning fault can show up too.
issues.why: Poor soldering in the sensors of the active air flaps behind the grille. Bulletin 24-BE-020G calls for new sensors.
issues.next: Have the code read and ask the dealer about bulletin 24-BE-020G.

issues.t: Genesis Connected Services stop working
issues.sym: Remote start, the app and other connected features stop working.
issues.why: The system can lose its cellular connection after an irregular disconnect on the network. Bulletin 25-01-024G covers it.
issues.next: A reset of the infotainment unit usually fixes it. Ask the dealer if it doesn't come back.

issues.t: Damaged rear floor panel from the factory
issues.sym: Usually nothing obvious, but bare or scratched metal under the right rear floor could rust later.
issues.why: Bulletin 25-01-034G covers factory damage to the passenger-side rear floor panel.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to inspect the panel; the fix is sanding and undercoating the area.
